purpose: SQL-to-expert routing contract for TESSERACT FrankenMoE

routing_evidence.positive_prompts: Required per expert; describe in-domain inputs.
routing_evidence.negative_prompts: Required per expert; describe exclusions and ambiguity.
routing_evidence.hidden_state_source: Final-layer representation from a pinned tokenizer/model revision.
routing_evidence.normalization: Use exact tokenizer and prompt template pinned in build receipt.

policy.multiple_experts: Top-k routing only when configured and measured
policy.sql_execution: Never execute generated SQL without independent authorization and query policy validation
